name: Backgammon (Declarative)
description: Each player rolls one opening die; reroll ties. The higher roll starts using both dice. Move all 15 checkers home and bear them off; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. Two opposing checkers block a point; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice and the higher die if only one is usable. Undo a move only while your turn is unfinished. Choose a match goal of 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 or 15 points. A gammon scores double and a backgammon triple. If enabled, offer the doubling cube before rolling; the opponent may take or drop. The cube changes match points, never the platform token pot. First to the chosen goal wins.

ui_instructions: Press the roll button or tap a die that is waiting to roll. Each player rolls one opening die; the higher roll starts. Select a green highlighted checker, then a highlighted destination, or drag it there. Doubles show four dice; used dice turn gray. Captured checkers must re-enter first. Undo is available during an unfinished turn. Hint highlights a legal move; Help explains the board. Both computer and pass-and-play use smooth checker and dice animations. The fitted board stays fixed without zoom or pan.

cases.name: Initial move
cases.description: Each player rolls one opening die; reroll ties. The higher roll starts using both dice. Move all 15 checkers home and bear them off; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. Two opposing checkers block a point; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice and the higher die if only one is usable. Undo a move only while your turn is unfinished. Choose a match goal of 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 or 15 points. A gammon scores double and a backgammon triple. If enabled, offer the doubling cube before rolling; the opponent may take or drop. The cube changes match points, never the platform token pot. First to the chosen goal wins.

cases.name: Terminal move
cases.description: Each player rolls one opening die; reroll ties. The higher roll starts using both dice. Move all 15 checkers home and bear them off; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. Two opposing checkers block a point; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice and the higher die if only one is usable. Undo a move only while your turn is unfinished. Choose a match goal of 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 or 15 points. A gammon scores double and a backgammon triple. If enabled, offer the doubling cube before rolling; the opponent may take or drop. The cube changes match points, never the platform token pot. First to the chosen goal wins.

cases.name: Bear off
cases.description: Each player rolls one opening die; reroll ties. The higher roll starts using both dice. Move all 15 checkers home and bear them off; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. Two opposing checkers block a point; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice and the higher die if only one is usable. Undo a move only while your turn is unfinished. Choose a match goal of 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 or 15 points. A gammon scores double and a backgammon triple. If enabled, offer the doubling cube before rolling; the opponent may take or drop. The cube changes match points, never the platform token pot. First to the chosen goal wins.

cases.name: Combined four ones
cases.description: Each player rolls one opening die; reroll ties. The higher roll starts using both dice. Move all 15 checkers home and bear them off; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. Two opposing checkers block a point; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice and the higher die if only one is usable. Undo a move only while your turn is unfinished. Choose a match goal of 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 or 15 points. A gammon scores double and a backgammon triple. If enabled, offer the doubling cube before rolling; the opponent may take or drop. The cube changes match points, never the platform token pot. First to the chosen goal wins.

es.short_description: Cada jugador lanza un dado inicial; los empates se repiten. El mayor empieza usando ambos dados. Lleva las 15 fichas a casa y retíralas; los dobles dan cuatro movimientos. Reingresa primero las fichas de la barra. Dos fichas rivales bloquean una punta; una sola se captura. Usa el máximo de dados y el mayor si solo puedes usar uno. Deshaz movimientos solo durante tu turno. Elige una meta de 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 o 15 puntos. Gammon vale doble y backgammon triple. Si está activo, ofrece el cubo antes de lanzar; el rival acepta o abandona. El cubo cambia los puntos, nunca el bote de fichas de la plataforma. Gana quien llegue a la meta.

fr.short_description: Chaque joueur lance un dé initial ; recommencez les égalités. Le plus fort commence avec les deux dés. Ramenez les 15 pions puis sortez-les ; un double donne quatre déplacements. Rentrez les pions de la barre en premier. Deux pions adverses bloquent une flèche ; un pion seul est frappé. Utilisez le maximum de dés et le plus fort si un seul est jouable. Annulez uniquement pendant votre tour. Choisissez 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 ou 15 points. Un gammon vaut double et un backgammon triple. Si activé, proposez le videau avant de lancer ; l’adversaire accepte ou abandonne. Le videau change les points, jamais la cagnotte de jetons. Le premier au score choisi gagne.

de.short_description: Jeder würfelt anfangs einen Würfel; bei Gleichstand erneut würfeln. Die höhere Zahl beginnt mit beiden Würfeln. Bringe 15 Steine heim und würfle sie heraus; ein Pasch gibt vier Züge. Steine auf der Bar zuerst einsetzen. Zwei gegnerische Steine sperren einen Punkt, ein einzelner wird geschlagen. Nutze möglichst viele Würfel, bei nur einem möglichen den höheren. Rücknahme nur im laufenden Zug. Wähle 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 oder 15 Punkte. Gammon zählt doppelt, Backgammon dreifach. Falls aktiviert, vor dem Würfeln doppeln; der Gegner nimmt an oder gibt auf. Der Doppler ändert Matchpunkte, nie den Token-Topf. Wer zuerst das Ziel erreicht, gewinnt.
